positions.name: OwnedAssetVsCommoditySubstrate
positions.frame: what is retained as the asset versus what is treated as commodity substrate when intelligence is owned rather than rented?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same categorical, unhedged antithesis (owned vs. rented; substrate vs. asset-you-keep), matched in register (aphoristic maxim), conviction (creed-level, unhedged principle), value appeal (autonomy/self-enhancement via possession), and relational framing (market-pricing bifurcation of commodity vs. retained asset) — a single directional read spanning two sentences that jointly state one thesis about ownership as the locus of value.
